description: Defines the QuicAlarm class and related delegate classes for scheduling and handling alarms in the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm
classes.description: Represents an alarm that triggers at a scheduled time, executing a delegate's OnAlarm method.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for alarm delegate, providing connection context and alarm callback.

classes.name: quic::QuicAlarm::DelegateWithoutContext
classes.description: Delegate without connection context, handling multiple connections.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the alarm to fire at a specified deadline.

methods.name: PermanentCancel
methods.description: Permanently cancels the alarm, preventing future scheduling.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the alarm's deadline if the new deadline is farther than the current one.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the alarm's deadline has been set.

methods.name: deadline
methods.description: Returns the current deadline of the alarm.
